checked: Independently re-derived by a checker on 2026-11-24. Where this file and ../audit.md differ, ../audit.md (checker-corrected) wins. Claim figures are banded on purpose: exact allegation figures would let a reader map this case to a named person.
what: Chart calibration from real on-chain trades, anonymized. OUR ESTIMATE from public Solana data, not the analytics firm's data and not a finding about any person.
method: 5-second OHLCV candles from every successful trade on the token's launchpad bonding curve, 10 min before to 30 min after the public wallet's first buy. Price = SOL per token at the curve (curve balance change), divided by the curve price of the public wallet's first buy, so that buy = 1.0. t = seconds from that buy (bucket start). Empty buckets are flat at the previous close (empty: true). After a token leaves the bonding curve for its AMM pool, the curve has no more trades and the series stays flat (noted per token). Events: the public wallet and a wallet group WE detected (linked by token transfers and co-signed transactions; not the analytics firm's published list). slot_offset = Solana slots from the public buy's slot (~0.4 s each); order_in_slot = rank among these wallets' transactions in the same block. SOL rounded to 0.1, volumes to 0.01 SOL.
caveats: Timing, transfers and co-signed transactions link the group's wallets to each other; they do not show who controls them, and nothing here links them to a named person.
Callout (post) times are not on-chain and were not reachable; events are relative to the public wallet's first buy.
Candles were validated: high >= max(open, close), low <= min(open, close), all prices > 0.
